title: Happy Father with Young Sons on Floor, 1958 B&W Domestic Snapshot Photo
description: A candid indoor photograph capturing a joyful father resting on the floor with his two young children, dated April 1958. The toddler in the foreground wears a novelty cowboy hat, emblematic of the mid-century American craze for Western television and radio serials. Between them sits an infant propped up by a toy ball under the father's supportive hand. The print features classic scalloped deckle edges and a top border stamp reading '• APR • 58', epitomizing the warmth of post-war suburban domestic family life.
